sources.notes: Filename prefix 'BMCE' and internal header read 'FWW BMCE v 1.0 22/06/2024 — Battle Mode Faction List'. This does NOT match the official Modiphius product-code convention seen on every other file in this capture (FOWW <code>-111) and carries no Bethesda/ZeniMax trademark footer anywhere in its 11 pages — both present on every other official document sampled, including the separate, differently-named official Battle Mode Rulebook (product code FOWW BTL-001-111, confirmed via a direct check of G:\...\BMCE-Rulebook-v-1-6 (2).pdf p.1-2, which DOES carry the official code and IS an official living-document PDF Modiphius hosts and updates). Whether the per-faction 'BMCE-*' Force List PDFs (Robots, Survivors, Raiders, etc., 14 files in Faction Rules/FWW/) are official Modiphius Battle Mode force lists using an internal shorthand, or a fan-maintained companion sharing similar naming, was NOT resolved by a web search this run (searches found the official Battle Mode program and its forums but no definition of the literal 'BMCE' acronym) [NOT FOUND]. Depth is therefore graded 'community reconstruction' rather than 'official PDF' in the hub, and its price figures are treated as reference-only, not FACT-tagged, pending confirmation.

web_verification_note: A web search this run corrected an assumption made mid-research: Fallout: Wasteland Warfare is NOT a discontinued line — Modiphius announced a Second Edition in active development, targeted for 2026. Do not carry forward any prior note framing FWW as abandoned/legacy.

Highest-priority follow-up capture.

Battle Mode Rulebook (FOWW BTL-001-111, v1.6) — the competitive/tournament ruleset; explicitly disables Settlement Mode, Solo/Co-op Mode, and all deck-based systems, so it is NOT where the settlement/hacking/AI material lives.

13 other BMCE-prefixed faction Force Lists (Survivors, Raiders, Brotherhood of Steel, Institute, NCR, Enclave, Gunners, Railroad, Children of Atom, Super Mutants, Creatures, Nuka-World Gangs) — same official-vs-fan uncertainty as robots.pdf.

Into The Vault (a separate boxed expansion, terminal/vault-crawl themed — 'Into The Vault - Rulebook.pdf' in Rule books/) — the name overlaps with 'Into the Wasteland' but is a distinct product; NOT read this run despite being a plausible high-hacking-density candidate.
